meta.name: prisma-driver-adapter-implementation
meta.description: Required reference for Prisma ORM 7 SQL driver adapter work. Use when implementing or modifying adapters, adding database drivers, or touching SqlDriverAdapter, Transaction, savepoint, result mapping, or DriverAdapterError behavior. Covers current transaction lifecycle, optional savepoint hooks, original database-error preservation, and verification.

howto.what: 写 Prisma 7 SQL 驱动适配器时,Claude 会按接口契约实现 SqlDriverAdapter、事务与 savepoint、结果映射和错误转换,并对着校验清单逐项检查连接、列类型和原始错误码是否保真。
howto.when: 当你实现或修改 Prisma 7 驱动适配器、新增数据库驱动,或触及事务生命周期、savepoint、结果映射等契约代码时会接管。

say.text: 帮我按 Prisma 驱动适配器契约实现 queryRaw 的结果映射
say.note: 会按 ColumnTypeEnum 映射列类型并保留精度

say.text: 检查我的 startTransaction 是否为每个事务分配独立连接
say.note: 对照连接与提交/回滚的释放规则逐条核对

say.text: 把驱动错误包成 DriverAdapterError 并保留原始错误码

howto.what_en: For Prisma 7 SQL driver adapter work, Claude implements the SqlDriverAdapter, transaction and savepoint, result-mapping and error-conversion contract, then checks connections, column types and preserved original error codes against the verification checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement or modify a Prisma 7 driver adapter, add a database driver, or touch the transaction lifecycle, savepoints, result mapping or DriverAdapterError behavior.

say_en.text: Implement queryRaw result mapping per the Prisma driver adapter contract
say_en.note: Maps column types via ColumnTypeEnum and keeps precision

say_en.text: Check that startTransaction gives each transaction its own dedicated connection
say_en.note: Verifies connection and commit/rollback release rules

say_en.text: Wrap driver errors in DriverAdapterError and keep the original code and message
say_en.note: Preserves originalCode so unmapped errors fall back to P2039
